name: ESPRIT ML — Rubric Complete Prediction Pipeline

nodes.name: 🌐 Webhook Trigger
nodes.notes: Receives POST /webhook/ml-predict with {temp, humidity} in the body. Acts as the on-demand trigger for manual / external calls.

nodes.name: ⏰ Cron Trigger (Hourly Auto-Predict)
nodes.notes: Fires every hour on the hour. Sends fixed sensor defaults to the prediction pipeline. Demonstrates automatic scheduled inference.

nodes.name: ✅ Validate Webhook Input
nodes.notes: Validates temp (°C) and humidity (%) from the webhook body. Throws a descriptive error for bad inputs before hitting the ML API.

nodes.name: 🔧 Build Cron Sensor Payload
nodes.notes: Generates a simulated sensor reading for each scheduled run. In production, replace with a DB query or external sensor API call.

nodes.name: 📡 POST /predict (ML Endpoint)
nodes.notes: Calls FastAPI POST /predict with temp+humidity. continueOnFail=true ensures errors reach the error branch. Retries 3×  with 2s delay.

nodes.name: 📡 POST /predict (Cron)
nodes.notes: Identical HTTP call as the webhook branch — same ML endpoint, same retry logic. Having separate nodes makes debugging each trigger independent.

nodes.name: ❓ Prediction Succeeded?
nodes.notes: Routes to Success branch (true) if FastAPI returned status=success. Routes to Error branch (false) for any failure, timeout, or non-200 response.

nodes.name: ❓ Cron Prediction OK?
nodes.notes: Identical success check for the cron branch. Separating IF nodes per trigger keeps each path independently traceable in the execution log.

nodes.name: 📊 Format Success Record
nodes.notes: Normalises the FastAPI success response into a uniform record shape ready for storage. Logs prediction value and latency.

nodes.name: 📊 Format Cron Success
nodes.notes: Same formatting logic as the webhook success node, but marks trigger='cron' for easy filtering in the predictions.json log.

nodes.name: 🚨 Handle Error + Log
nodes.notes: Captures ALL errors — HTTP 4xx/5xx, timeouts, network failures — from both webhook and cron branches. Logs actor, status, and full error detail.

nodes.name: 💾 Confirm Storage (JSON)
nodes.notes: Enriches the prediction record with n8n metadata (execution ID, workflow name). The actual file write is handled by FastAPI automatically on each /predict call.

nodes.name: ✅ Return 200 Success
nodes.notes: Returns HTTP 200 with the full prediction record to the webhook caller. Custom headers identify the gateway.

nodes.name: ❌ Return 422 Error
nodes.notes: Returns HTTP 422 with structured error body to the webhook caller. Error records are NOT saved to predictions.json.
